face_threshold_basis: Engineering placeholder for v2 IPD regional ratio deltas (changed 2026-09-11); requires fresh tuning. Not fitted to data or inferred from performance percentages.
arm_threshold_basis: User-selected demo rule for a 2D shoulder-wrist descent proxy. The cited values describe sensor-measured pronation summaries, not validated drift cutoffs.

ipronator.summary_statistic: Group medians of per-person metrics, not diagnostic decision thresholds
ipronator.measurement: Forearm-mounted accelerometers; pronation is not observable from YOLO's shoulder/elbow/wrist locations alone

fast_meta_analysis.note: 0.86 is this estimate's upper confidence bound, used here only as a project stretch target. This prototype does not implement speech testing.
